subject: Acme Health SOC 2 & logging discussion — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmehealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Health SOC 2 & logging discussion — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Alex / Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our discovery so we’re aligned heading into procurement/security review:

Summary of pain points / goals
- You need continuous, tamper-evident audit logs for all inference requests and admin actions (retention: 7 years preferred, 2 years minimum).
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and third-party pen test summaries are required for your security review.
- Data residency + VPC/private deployment are evaluation criteria for PHI/PII workloads.
- DPA + reasonable SLAs around data access/deletion and breach notification are mandatory.

What Redwood can commit to (high-level)
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II report and a redacted pen-test summary (attached).
- Audit logs: request-level logs & admin audit trails can be exported; retention is configurable — we’ll propose an export+storage pattern that meets 7-year retention.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA (attached) and will work with your legal team on specific redlines.
- Private deployment options (VPC + customer-managed KMS) are available for regulated workloads.

Action items / owners / timeline
1) Redwood (Marissa) — Share SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, sample audit-log export by EOD tomorrow. (Attachments included)
2) Acme (Alex) — Confirm final retention target and any additional log fields your auditors need by 2027-04-09.
3) Redwood (Neha) — Schedule a technical security call next week to walk architect/security teams through logging, KMS, and VPC options. Proposed windows: Wed/Thu mornings PT.
4) Redwood legal (Rishi) — Kick off DPA review; share DocuSign link to standard DPA.

Proposed next meeting: 30–45 minute security deep-dive with your security team + our security engineer (Neha). Can you confirm availability for Wed 04/07 or Thu 04/08 morning PT?

Attachments (stubs):
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-Inference-2026.pdf (redacted)
- pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (executive summary)
- Redwood-DPA-2027.docx
- audit-logs-export-sample.csv (sample schema)

If anything above looks off, flag and I’ll adjust. Looking forward to the security deep-dive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Health SOC 2 & logging discussion — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is really helpful and aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifying items from our side:

- Retention: 7 years is preferred, but our baseline is 2 years for audit purposes. We’ll confirm final requirement by EOD 04/09.
- Audit log fields we need: request_id, timestamp, model_id, input_hash (pseudonymized), response_hash, user_id (if present), request_metadata, admin_action, source_ip. Can Redwood provide a sample CSV (schema + 10 rows) for our security team to validate?
- Encryption: confirm that data at rest is encrypted with customer-managed keys for Private deployments. For hosted API, can you confirm AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit?
- DPA: we’ll have our legal team send redline requests. Please send the DocuSign link and point of contact for negotiations.

We’re available for the security deep-dive on Wed 04/07 09:00–10:00 PT or Thu 04/08 09:30–10:15 PT. Prefer Wed if Neha is available.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner
Director of IT Security, Acme Health
alex.turner@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0147

Marissa — quick internal note after Alex looped legal:

- Legal will likely request two small DPA redlines: (1) reasonable audit rights window, (2) data deletion verification clause. We can accept both with standard language; flagging for transparency.
- Pricing/procurement: Acme is evaluating private deployment for PHI; we should prepare Dedicated SKU pricing + 6-month pilot discount to help close. Can you draft a one-pager pricing addendum for the pilot (target: 6 months, 20% off list) and share by EOD today so I can review before the security call?
- Neha: please be prepared to walk through the KMS workflow and the audit-log export retention options on the call.
